title.narrative: Mangochi District Council - Health and HIV Treatment Activity (Government -to - Government)

description.narrative: (Malawi): In line with USAID's vision of system strengthening for greater sustainability and resilience, USAID entered into a direct three-year government to government agreement with Mangochi District Council. This integrated health activity will implement critical health activities that will contribute to the improvement of maternal and child health; voluntary family planning; and nutrition service delivery. FY 2022 funds will enable the Mangochi District Council to: 1) implement family health services through integrated outreach and mobile visits; 2) strengthen the procurement of essential equipment, data collection, and usage; 3) operationalize the community health strategy; and 4) provide supportive supervision and on-the-job mentoring to promote quality of care at facility and community levels. The activity will support the recruitment of two hundred and thirty one priority health care workers and one support staff using the Government of Malawi's recruitment and salary payment systems. The direct funding support will enhance Malawi's pathway to locally led development through building sustainable and resilient health systems with increased efficiency, transparency, and accountability..This activity supports the Integrated Country Strategy Mission Objective 1.2 - Public service providers improve the integrity and quality of public services, particularly those supported with U.S. foreign assistance and 3.2 - Malawi improves access to and quality of health services so that more of its citizens gain and retain full health and can contribute productively at home, in the community, and at work...
